args: const { Server } = require('@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/index.js'); const { StdioServerTransport } = require('@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js'); const puppeteer = require('puppeteer'); const server = new Server({ name: 'puppeteer-mcp-server', version: '1.0.0' }, { capabilities: { tools: {} } }); server.setRequestHandler('tools/call', async (request) => { const { name, arguments: args } = request.params; if (name === 'fetch_webpage') { const browser = await puppeteer.launch({ headless: true }); const page = await browser.newPage(); await page.goto(args.url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle0' }); const content = await page.content(); const text = await page.evaluate(() => document.body.innerText || ''); await browser.close(); return { content: { type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ html: content, text: text, url: args.url }) } }; } }); server.setRequestHandler('tools/list', async () => ({ tools: [{ name: 'fetch_webpage', description: '抓取网页内容，包括HTML和纯文本', inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: { url: { type: 'string', description: '要抓取的网页URL' } }, required: ['url'] } }] })); const transport = new StdioServerTransport(); server.connect(transport);
